Create 5 separate images, one after the other (5 images, each its own full 16:9 frame, no panels, no text). Concept art keyframes for an original dark fantasy action game, each a 16:9 landscape frame in an anime action style: hard-edged cel-shaded effect shapes in 2-3 flat tones with dark ink outlines and white-hot cores, ink-brush smears, speed lines, a held dramatic pose, low cinematic camera. A dark ash-grey and blue-black ruined stone arena under falling ash, lit mostly by the technique, which is the brightest, most saturated thing in the frame; few big sharp particles, never soft fog as the main shape. The hero is a lone swordsman in a dark hooded coat with a long red scarf and a round shield, face hidden in shadow. Original designs only: no existing characters, logos, symbols, text, letters or watermarks.

Image 1: the swordsman mid-swing, a razor-thin white glint racing along the edge of the blade, a faint bone-coloured ink streak trailing it. Colour: bone-white and grey ink only, small and quick (a single brush stroke or a few sharp sparks). If a boss is in the scene, it is a huge antlered beast of hunger.

Image 2: close on the swordsman's gauntleted forearm, dark iron-grey veins spreading under the skin like cooling metal, bone-white sparks. Colour: bone-white and grey ink only, small and quick (a single brush stroke or a few sharp sparks). If a boss is in the scene, it is a chained jailer giant with an iron cage for a head.

Image 3: the swordsman landing from a dash, three slim white bars of light at their feet refilling, a single ink-brush feather flicking off the heel. Colour: bone-white and grey ink only, small and quick (a single brush stroke or a few sharp sparks). If a boss is in the scene, it is a tall warden in tattered robes swinging a great bell.

Image 4: the swordsman drinking from a small glowing amber flask while running, a quick bone-ink motion smear around the flask. Colour: bone-white and grey ink only, small and quick (a single brush stroke or a few sharp sparks). If a boss is in the scene, it is a knight made of ash and cracked armour.
